text.tspan: the units whose value is large but whose gate is nearly shut

Each hidden unit multiplies two different views of the same word. A unit can be silenced by its gate whatever its value says — in a plain feed-forward, a unit can only silence itself by its own value. Training teaches the gates when to open; on this untrained model they are still random.
